prompts.prompt: Build me a page from our Human contacts where I can mark someone as contacted today, and see it update. One HTML file, give me the HTML at the end.
I want a page on our Human data that lists contacts and lets me add a new one without leaving it. One HTML file, HTML at the end.
Make me a page listing our Human contacts with a switch on each one for active or inactive that actually saves. One HTML file, HTML at the end.
Build a page from our Human contacts that lets me edit a person's job title inline and save it. One HTML file, HTML at the end.
